summary.text: Marty Overweg is a Republican state representative from District 21 who is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He owns and operates feed businesses in New Holland and Wagner and chairs two House committees.

paragraphs.text: Marty Overweg is a resident of New Holland and owns and operates Overweg Feed and Wagner Feed Supply, according to Ballotpedia.

In the 2025-2026 session, Overweg chairs the House Agriculture and Natural Resources Committee and the House Government Operations and Audit Committee, and is vice chair of the House State Affairs Committee.
He advanced from the Republican primary on June 2, 2026.
